_meta.title: Crime against Foreigners in India, 2014-2021
_meta.source: National Crime Records Bureau (NCRB), Ministry of Home Affairs, GoI. Chapter 13A of the annual 'Crime in India' report. FTA (foreign tourist arrivals) from the Ministry of Tourism, GoI.
_meta.compiled_by: Vishal Tikhute, distributed via Mendeley Data
_meta.note: No state/UT-wise breakdown of this series is available without a data.gov.in API key (not obtainable in this environment) -- see app/services/crime_index.py for how this national series is used as a calibration anchor rather than a per-state lookup. 2020-2021 crime RATE spikes are a COVID-19 artifact (foreign tourist arrivals collapsed ~87%, so the same or lower case count divides into a far smaller denominator) and are excluded from the pre-COVID baseline used for calibration -- flagged explicitly rather than read as tourists becoming more likely to be victimised.
